verdict.rationale: Deel's founders page lists the pathways it offers (O-1A, EB-2NIW, EB1-A, L-1, E-2, H-1B) but never mentions International Entrepreneur Rule parole or its qualifying-investment thresholds. A founder-focused immigration service could plausibly offer IER parole, so the axis applies and the lack of evidence makes this none.

support.subject: As a founder, the International Entrepreneur Rule (parole) is documented as an offered pathway, with its qualifying-investment thresholds stated
